notes: Oklahoma adopts the federal rate by reference for employers with 10+ full-time employees at a location or gross sales over $100,000 (DOL table).
No state meal-period requirement for adults in the DOL table; federal law does not require one.
No state paid rest-period requirement in the DOL table; federal law does not require one.
No state daily overtime listed in the DOL table.
Drafted from US DOL WHD state tables (confidence=medium) on 2026-11-06; upgrade to primary sources pending.
minimum_wage.effective is the DOL table date (2026-11-05), not the statutory effective date.

Minors (Oklahoma DOL brochure): no Oklahoma hour limits for 16-17. Under-16 need a 30-minute rest period per 5 hours worked and a 1-hour rest period per 8 hours (not encoded: no minor-break type). Under-16 may not cook/bake or use fryers, grills or slicers (not encoded as role tags).

rules.summary: Oklahoma's basic minimum wage is $7.25 an hour (DOL table, Nov. 2026).

rules.summary: When school is in session, 14- and 15-year-olds may work outside school hours at most 3 hours on a school day (including Friday) and 18 hours a week, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. June 1-Labor Day).

citation.title: Oklahoma Dept. of Labor — Child Labor brochure (hours of work, under 16)
citation.excerpt: 3 hours on a school day, including Friday. 18 hours a week when school is in session.

rules.summary: When school is not in session, 14- and 15-year-olds may work at most 8 hours a day and 40 a week, 7 a.m.-7 p.m. (9 p.m. June 1-Labor Day).

citation.title: Oklahoma Dept. of Labor — Child Labor brochure (hours of work, under 16)
citation.excerpt: 8 hours per day or 40 hours per week when school isn't in session.
